figure_description: A Cartesian coordinate system with a horizontal axis labeled x and a vertical axis labeled f(x). The origin is labeled O. The axes have evenly spaced tick marks representing 1 unit each. An upward-opening parabola is drawn on the plane. Three points on the parabola are marked with an '×' and labeled with coordinates: the x-intercepts (-1, 0) and (2, 0), and the y-intercept (0, -4). The vertex of the parabola is located in the fourth quadrant below (0, -4).
